title: skills/objectui guides still teach `@object-ui/plugin-ai`, a package retired by #25921 (PR #27042)
body:
Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966, `session_01JQwxbZeBv2y91towxasSUT`) as the `Skills-docs:` follow-up owed by PR #27042 (`Metadata-protocol: narrowed`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`). The plugin-ai ruling on PR #26365 (comment `6439038287`) keeps these two mentions out of that PR: "The two `skills/objectui/guides/*` mentions stay in their own governed follow-up as the body says." ⛔ Not a claim; left for triage. Parent: #25921.

## Symptom

After PR #27042 lands, `@object-ui/plugin-ai` no longer exists in the workspace and is no longer published. Two skill guides still teach it (lines on `main` `acc9c57d`):

- `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md:75` lists `"@object-ui/plugin-ai": "latest"` in a sample `package.json`. An AI author who copies it gets an install that resolves to the last published version of a retired package.
- `skills/objectui/guides/page-builder.md:328` lists `plugin-ai` beside `plugin-chatbot` in the AI row of the plugin table.

## Expected

Both guides stop naming `@object-ui/plugin-ai`. The sample `package.json` drops the line, and the table row lists only what ships. If the AI row then has a real successor to point at (`plugin-chatbot` alone, or nothing), say so in the row. The three retired node types (`ai-form-assist`, `ai-recommendations`, `nl-query`) are refused by name with a remedy, which is in `ui/packages/types/src/zod/ai.zod.ts` on #27042's head. The guide should not teach them.

## Filing facts

- Business reason: skills are what AI authors read first. A guide that installs a retired package is the exact drift the skills lane exists to prevent.
- Reader who acts: the triage seat, then the skills lane. `skills/**` is a governed surface (Tier H) and ships in `@objectstack/skills`, so it takes a patch changeset and evals as that lane requires. Land it after #27042.
- Dedupe: every open issue on this repo (newest 500, REST) grepped for `plugin-ai`. The hits are #25921 itself and a tracking line; no card covers the skills guides.
